scope_notes: The 30-minute long-stability and graph-admission runs used 56 input tokens; the separate 100-request V05 reliability run uses exact 256/64 tokens, but is not a 30-minute run.
The forced-fallback experiment is a single low-frequency smoke point and does not complete the planned 0.1/1/10/50/100 percent fallback matrix.
The CUDA Graph arena-capture run failed after graph warmup with heap corruption; this is a negative capability result, not a performance result.
No raw trace files were retained; temporary remote trace roots were checked and removed after validation.

round_replacement.reason: known archive generation overlapped original first round; predetermined replacement before aggregate Llama analysis

orin_f16.experiment: Jetson Orin Nano Super Qwen3-0.6B F16 precision extension

workload.profile_scope: all Neutrino-covered block_sched frames; dynamic/callback off

notes: The performance matrix uses the same 64 MiB host/device ring budgets and stdio writer for G and R.
The 64 MiB single-Map bound is an isolated F16-compatible build; original Q4 binaries/sources were not modified.
The model precision is available only on Jetson in this run; this is not the planned discrete-GPU F16 matrix.
Five paired process rounds are exploratory; phase counters describe where differences appear, not a unique causal decomposition.

limitations: Only three process rounds per condition; report stage mechanisms descriptively, without new confidence claims.

Diagnostic request times are roughly 10-13 ms/request above the independent non-diagnostic seven-round A02 means; the difference is only an instrumentation/period sensitivity signal, not a paired estimate of timer overhead.
Summed hook sample durations can overlap across submission threads and exceed application time; they are not an additive request-time budget.
Writer counters and hook clocks are overlapping views; do not sum them or infer that a stage delta is a causal latency delta.
A02 factors compare capacity and D2H timing for this Qwen 39/32 workload only.

diagnostic_perturbation.scope_note: A05 timing diagnostics use only the on-side; off-side gives the uninstrumented endpoint. GPU event intervals overlap host stages and are not additive.

V03.interpretation: Exact integer queries on encoded records compared with their same-execution raw Map oracle; not native timing ground truth or cross-tool precision/recall.
